subject: planner: refactor FindBestTask and move FindBestTask4LogicalTableDual (#63863)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for planner-only changes. This commit removes `base.LogicalPlan.FindBestTask`, centralizes dispatch in `physicalop.FindBestTask`, updates core/cascades callers accordingly, and moves the `LogicalTableDual` (and test-only mock datasource) best-task logic into `physicalop`. `LogicalPartitionUnionAll.PushDownTopN` is adjusted to preserve the partition-union wrapper when attaching `TopN` (matching `LogicalUnionAll` semantics). No remaining Blocker/High correctness/SQL-semantics issues found; later `upstream/master` history continues related refactors without indicating a regression fix for this change.
